memory_verse: Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity, which he hath given thee under the sun, all the days of thy vanity: for that is thy portion in this life, and in thy labour which thou takest under the sun.

title: OKUN FUN AWON TI O RE
topic: OKUN FUN AWON TI O RE
memory_verse: Okan mi nro fun are, iwo mu mi lara le gege bi oro re

title: STRENGTH TO THE WEARY
memory_verse: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word

title: ISIPOPADA
memory_verse: Nitoripe awa o sa ku, a o si dabi omi ti a tu sile ti a ko si le sajo mo; nitori bi Olorun ko ti gba emi re, o si ti se ona ki a ma ba le isansa re kuro lodo re.

title: THE TRANSITION
memory_verse: For we must needs die, and are as water spilt on the ground, which cannot be gathered up again; neither doth God respect any person: yet doth he devise means, that his banished be not expelled from him.

title: FINISHING WELL
memory_verse: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.

title: PIPARI DARADARA
memory_verse: E ma ronu awon nkan ti mbe loke ki ise awon nkan ti mbe li aiye.

title: APERE RERE
memory_verse: Mase jeki enikeni ki o gan ewe re; sugbon ki iwo ki o je apre fun awon ti o gbagbo, ninu oro, ninu iwa hihu, ninu ife, ninu emi, ninu igbagbo, ninu iwa mimo.

title: GOOD EXAMPLE
memory_verse: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

title: WORK; THE EVIDENCE OF FAITH
memory_verse: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.

title: ISE; ERI IGBAGBO
memory_verse: Nitori bi ara li aisi emi ti je oku, be gege pelu ni igbagbo li aisi ise je oku

title: WORSHIP
memory_verse: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.

title: ISIN
memory_verse: Sugbon wakati n ambo, o si de tan nisisiyi, nigbati awon olusin toto yio ma sin Baba li emi ati li otito: nitori iru won ni Baba nwa ki o ma sin on.

title: GBIGBA ALEJO
memory_verse: Sugbon ati ma sore on ati ma pinfunni e mase gbagbe: nitori iru ebo wonni ni inu Olorun dun si jojo.

title: HOSPITALITY
memory_verse: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.

title: IHINRERE TI O MUNA
memory_verse: Ki emi ki o le fihan, gege bi o ti to fun mi lati ma so.

title: EFFECTIVE EVANGELISM
memory_verse: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak

title: ATILEHIN ATI SISO ENIYAN DI OMO EHIN KRISTI
topic: ATILEHIN ATI SISO ENIYAN DI OMO EHIN KRISTI
memory_verse: Nitori naa e lo, e ma ko orile-ede gbogbo, ki e si ma baptisi won li oruko Baba, ati ni ti Omo, ati ni ti Emi Mimo

title: FOLLOW UP AND DISCIPLESHIP
memory_verse: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost.

title: AJEJI OBIRIN
memory_verse: Ko si eniti o to o lo ti o sit un pada sehin, be ni nwon ki ide ipa ona iye.

title: STRANGE WOMAN
memory_verse: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.

title: JIJE OLOOTO NI IGBEYAWO
memory_verse: Ma fi ayo ba aya re gbe ti iwo fe ni gbogbo ojo aiye asan re, ti o fi fun o labe orun ni gbogbo ojo asan re: nitori eyini ni ipin tire li aiye yi, ati ninu lala ti iwo se labe orun.

title: FAITHFULNESS IN MARRIAGE
memory_verse: Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity, which he hath given thee under the sun, all the days of thy vanity: for that is thy portion in this life, and in thy labour which thou takest under the sun.

title: NINI IMOYE ARA ENI
memory_verse: Be gege enyin oko, e ma fi oye baa won aya nyin gbe, e ma fi ola fun aya, bi ohun elo ti ko lagbara, ati pelu bi ajumo-jogun ore-ofe iye, ki adura nyin ki o ma ba ni idena.

title: EMOTIONAL INTELLIGENCE
memory_verse: Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.

title: EJIKA TI A LE GBORI LE
topic: EJIKA TI A LE GBORI LE
memory_verse: Jeki orison re ki o ni ibukun: ki iwo o si ma yo tiwo ti aya igba ewe re.

title: SHOULDER TO LEAN ON
memory_verse: Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.

title: PARENTAL COUNSEL
memory_verse: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.

title: FI ANU HAN
memory_verse: Nitori anu ni mo fe, ki ise ebo; ati imo Olorun ju ore-ebo sisun lo.

title: SHOW MERCY
memory_verse: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.

title: SISA ERE IJE PELU AFORITI
memory_verse: Ati olukuluku eniti njijadu ati bori a ma ni iwontunwonsi ninu ohun gbogbo. Nje nwon se e lati gba ade idibaje; sugbon awa eyi ti ki idibaje.

title: RUNNING THE RACE WITH ENDURANCE
memory_verse: And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things. Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown, we an incorruptible.

title: IFE OLORUN
memory_verse: Ireti ki si idojuti ni; nitori a ti tan ife Olorun ka wa loâ€™kan lati odo Emi Mimo wa ti a fi fun wa.

title: THE LOVE OF GOD
memory_verse: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.

title: GBONGBO OHUN BUBURU GBOGBO
memory_verse: Nitori Ife owo ni gbongbo ohun buburu gbogbo, eyiti awon miran nlepa ti a si mu won sako kuro ninu igbagbo, won si fi ibinuje pupo gun ara won li oko.

title: ROOT OF BITTERNESS
memory_verse: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled

title: DIVINE DIRECTION
memory_verse: And the Lord went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night

title: ILANA TI O MU NA
memory_verse: Mase ye ala ile igbani, ti awon baba re ti pa.

title: SOUND DOCTRINE
memory_verse: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.

title: THE CONDITION OF THE HEART (PART 1)
memory_verse: My son, give me your heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.

title: IPO TI OKAN WA (APA KINI)
memory_verse: Omo mi, fi aiya re fun mi, ki o si je ki oju re ki o ni inu-didun si ona mi.

title: THE CONDITION OF THE HEART (PART 2)
memory_verse: For this peopleâ€™s heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.

title: IPO TI OKAN WA (APA KEJI)
memory_verse: Nitori aiya awon eniyan yi sebo, eti won si wuwo oran igbo, oju won ni nwon si di, nitori ki nwon ki o ma ba fi oju won ri, ki nwon ki o ma ba fi eti won gbo, kin won ki o ma ba yipada, ki emi ki o ma ba mu won larada.

title: IPO TI OKAN WA (APA KETA)
memory_verse: E mase aniyan ohunkohun, sugbon ninu ohun gbogbo, nipa adura ati ebe pelu idupe, e ma fi ibere nyin han fun Olorun.

title: THE CONDITION OF THE HEART (PART 3)
memory_verse: Be careful for nothing; but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.

title: IPO TI OKAN WA (APA KERIN)
memory_verse: Awon wonyi si ni iyin ju awon ti Tessalonika lo, niti pe nwon fi tokantokan gba oro na, nwon si nwa inu iwe-mimo lojojumo bi nkan wonyi ri be.

title: THE CONDITION OF THE HEART (PART 4)
memory_verse: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scripture daily, whether those things were so.

title: IPEHINDA
memory_verse: Yipada, enyin omo apehinda, emi o si wo ipehinda nyin san; sa wo, awa to o wa, nitori iwo li Oluwa Olorun wa.

title: BACKSLIDING
memory_verse: Return ye backsliding children, and I will heal your backslidings. Behold, we come unto thee; for thou art the LORD our God.

title: E FI IWA RERE KUN IGBAGBO
topic: E FI IWA RERE KUN IGBAGBO
memory_verse: Ati nitori eyi na papa, e ma se aisimi gbogbo, e fi iwarere kun igbagbo.

title: ADD VIRTUE TO FAITH
memory_verse: And beside this, giving diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge.

title: NINI IWA TI O TO NI AKOKO ISORO
topic: NINI IWA TI O TO NI AKOKO ISORO
memory_verse: mo mo bi a ti ise dir ire sile, mo mo bi a ti ise di pupo: li ohunkohun ati li ohun gbogbo mo ti ko asiri ati ma je ajeyo ati lati wa li aije, lati ma ni aniju ati lati se alaini.

title: POSSESSING THE RIGHT ATTITUDE IN TIME OF TRIAL
topic: POSSESSING THE RIGHT ATTITUDE IN TIME OF TRIAL
memory_verse: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.

title: AGABAGEBE
memory_verse: Gege be li enyin pelu farahan li ode bi olododo fun eniyan, sugbon ninu e kun fun agabagebe ati ese.

title: HYPOCRISY
memory_verse: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

title: OBEDIENCE
memory_verse: And Samuel said, Hath the Lord as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the Lord? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.

title: IGBORAN
memory_verse: Samueli si wipe, Oluwa ha ni inu didun si ore sisun ati ebo bi pe ki a gba ohun Oluwa gbo? Kiye si i, igboran san ju ebo lo, ifetisile si san ju ora agbo lo.

title: THE SIGNS OF END TIME ARE HERE
topic: THE SIGNS OF END TIME ARE HERE
memory_verse: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, tell us, when shall these things be? And what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?

title: CHRISTMAS
memory_verse: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called wonderful, counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.

title: KERESIMESI
memory_verse: Nitori a bi omo kan fun wa: ijoba yio si wa li ejika re: a o si ma pe oruko re ni Iyanu, Oludamoran, Olorun Alagbara, Baba Aiyeraiye, Omo-Alade Alafia.
